config.label: Absolute path to the Blender 3
config.description: Absolute path to the Blender 3.0+ executable. Leave unset to discover it on PATH and at the platform's standard install locations.

config.label: Ceiling for one Blender job in milliseconds
config.description: Ceiling for one Blender job in milliseconds. Renders and heavy conversions are the slow ones.

config.label: Directory for outputs written when a tool is called without an explicit output path
config.description: Directory for outputs written when a tool is called without an explicit output path.

config.label: Set to 0 to withdraw blender_run_python, which executes caller-supplied Python inside Blender, from the advertised tool list
config.description: Set to 0 to withdraw blender_run_python, which executes caller-supplied Python inside Blender, from the advertised tool list.

config.label: Ceiling on inlined image bytes
config.description: Ceiling on inlined image bytes. Past this the image stays on disk and the response says where.

config.label: Longest edge of the render copy returned inline in a tool result
config.description: Longest edge of the render copy returned inline in a tool result. The full-resolution PNG is always written to disk.

config.label: How many Blender processes may run at once
config.description: How many Blender processes may run at once. Further calls queue rather than compete for memory.

config.label: Base URL of the three
config.description: Base URL of the three.ws deployment backing blender_forge_import.

config.label: Ceiling for one text-to-3D generation in milliseconds
config.description: Ceiling for one text-to-3D generation in milliseconds.

config.label: Meshy/Tripo API key for the bring-your-own-key geometry lane
config.description: Meshy/Tripo API key for the bring-your-own-key geometry lane. The default image lane is free and needs no key.
